configurePresets.description: The developer default. Release is NOT optional: felitronics_spectrum_pane_perf_tests fails an unoptimised build (19 s against 1 s).

configurePresets.name: wasm-audio
configurePresets.description: Every default module built for wasm32 with exceptions and RTTI OFF and no pthreads, tests run in node. Needs emsdk on PATH ($EMSDK set by emsdk_env.sh). The link-time physics of the tier (8 MB stack, growable heap, assertions) lives in CMakeLists under if(EMSCRIPTEN); this preset carries the POLICY. -ffp-contract=off is stated even though baseline wasm has no scalar FMA to contract with, so the numeric contract survives a toolchain that grows one.

testPresets.name: wasm-audio
testPresets.description: ctest drives each test .js through node — the Emscripten toolchain sets CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR for us.
